text:
Dana: Morning 045. Had corpcard set to USD but used a local rideshare in Tokyo paid in JPY. Driver only accepted cash for tip. Total JPY 4,720 (fare JPY 4,200 + cash tip JPY 520). Card transaction shows USD 34.18 posted. How do I submit this split fare+cash tip?

Owen: Hi Dana 00. Reimbursable. Please upload the app receipt screenshot (shows JPY fare) and a photo of the cash tip note you left. We need to record the cash tip separately as petty cash.

Dana: Uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/tokyo_ride_0329.png and bank post: https://files.redwood.example/bank/corp_tx_2065432100.png Fare shows JPY 4,200. No VAT.

Maya: Quick policy note: cash tips under JPY 1,000 are reimbursable when card unusable for tip. Code the fare to GL 6102 (Travel) and the tip to petty cash GL 6995. Tag PROJ-99 if client-facing.

AP-bot: Checklist: required for foreign currency card tx reimbursement -> original receipt (app screenshot), card posting screenshot, explanation for cash tip, manager approval if > $100 equiv. Missing manager approval?

Dana: Client was present (Kiko Tan, Sato Corp). Manager approval from Owen (cc00) in thread. Mark PROJ-99.

Owen: Approved. Looks good. Also include currency conversion note: include rate used by bank or card processor. If you want finance to book using the posted USD amount we use that for GL; FX variance will be auto-accounted.

Dana: Added note in the portal: "use posted USD 34.18; cash tip JPY 520 reimbursable petty cash". Submitted: https://expenses.redwood.example/submit/2065432100

Maya: Received. Finance will process fare as USD 34.18 (GL 6102, PROJ-99) and petty cash reimbursement for JPY 520 converted at bank rate (GL 6995). Expect reimbursement in next expense run.

finance-bot: Thread summary: receipts attached -> fare coded GL 6102 (PROJ-99) -> tip petty cash GL 6995 -> manager approval present -> use posted USD for booking -> thread closed for processing.
